_readme: WP3 (Dart engine) edge cases for reward engine v2 (plan C3/C5 with contract changes D7, D9, D10). Owned by WP3; both engines load this file.
Assertions as 00_contract.json: points, cashback_inr, value_inr (2 dp), rule_id, excluded, cap_deltas (exact; zero deltas omitted).
Each expected value is worked by hand in `why`. All data is synthetic. The top-level 'directory' replaces db/fixtures/merchant_directory.json for this file.

scenarios.name: D01 MCC include matches
scenarios.why: MCC 5411 is in the rule's list and the category matches: 10 blocks x 5 = 50 pts (base 10 + bonus 40).

reward_rules.display_note: Up to 50x on selected partner offers

scenarios.name: D02 unknown MCC, category stands in
scenarios.why: No MCC captured; the rule's category matches and stands in for the MCC (C3.3.7): 50 pts.

reward_rules.display_note: Up to 50x on selected partner offers

scenarios.name: D03 known MCC outside the list blocks the rule
scenarios.why: MCC 5999 is known and not 5411, so the grocery rule fails although the category matches; base 10 pts.

reward_rules.display_note: Up to 50x on selected partner offers

scenarios.name: D04 MCC-only rule matches its MCC
scenarios.why: Electronics MCC 5732, no category needed: 4 x 10 = 40 pts.

reward_rules.display_note: Up to 50x on selected partner offers

scenarios.name: D05 MCC-only rule needs the MCC
scenarios.why: No MCC and the rule has no category to stand in, so it does not apply; base 10 pts.

reward_rules.display_note: Up to 50x on selected partner offers

scenarios.name: D06 mcc_exclude blocks the rule
scenarios.why: Dining at a bar (MCC 5813) is excluded from the dining rule; base 10 pts.

reward_rules.display_note: Up to 50x on selected partner offers

scenarios.name: D07 exclusion by MCC beats any priority
scenarios.why: Cash withdrawal MCC 6011: the exclusion wins although its priority number (500) is the highest.

reward_rules.display_note: Up to 50x on selected partner offers

scenarios.name: D08 info rule never ranks
scenarios.why: The unrestricted 50x info rule is display-only; unknown rail misses the swipe rule; base 10 pts.

reward_rules.display_note: Up to 50x on selected partner offers

scenarios.name: D09 priority tie goes to the higher rate
scenarios.why: Two travel rules at priority 15; 3 pts beats 2 pts although it is listed second: 30 pts.

reward_rules.display_note: Up to 50x on selected partner offers

scenarios.name: D10 expired rule is ignored
scenarios.why: The movies rule ended 2026-10-31; the spend is on 2026-11-10; base 10 pts.

reward_rules.display_note: Up to 50x on selected partner offers

scenarios.name: D11 longest alias picks the sub-brand; parent cap applies
scenarios.why: 'SWIGGY INSTAMART' resolves to instamart (longest alias): 60 pts = base 10 + bonus 50; the child cap and its parent both count 50.

reward_rules.display_note: Up to 50x on selected partner offers

scenarios.name: D12 parent cap binds through the child
scenarios.why: The parent bonus cap has 20 pts left: base 10 + bonus 20 = 30; both caps count 20.

reward_rules.display_note: Up to 50x on selected partner offers

scenarios.name: D13 a parent brand does not match a child-only rule
scenarios.why: 'Swiggy' resolves to swiggy; ancestors go up, never down, so the Instamart rule does not apply; base 10 pts.

reward_rules.display_note: Up to 50x on selected partner offers

scenarios.name: D14 VPA prefix wins over the merchant text
scenarios.why: The VPA handle starts with 'instamart', so the name 'Zomato' is ignored: 60 pts.

reward_rules.display_note: Up to 50x on selected partner offers

scenarios.name: D15 explicit merchant_slug is used as given
scenarios.why: The caller already resolved the merchant; the unrelated name is not re-resolved: 60 pts.

reward_rules.display_note: Up to 50x on selected partner offers

scenarios.name: D16 platform rule with a count cap that has room
scenarios.why: SmartBuy 10 x 10 = 100 pts; the count cap has 3 left and consumes 1.

reward_rules.display_note: Up to 50x on selected partner offers

scenarios.name: D17 exhausted count cap pays the base rate
scenarios.why: No bonus transactions left: all ₹1,000 is overflow at the base rate (10 pts); the count cap consumes 0.

reward_rules.display_note: Up to 50x on selected partner offers

scenarios.name: D18 block_inr overrides the unit block
scenarios.why: 3 pts per ₹150: ₹450 is 3 blocks = 9 pts (base floor(4.5) = 4).

reward_rules.display_note: Up to 50x on selected partner offers

scenarios.name: D19 flat points with a bonus cap
scenarios.why: 50 pts once; base 10 + bonus 40, but only 20 bonus pts are left: 30 pts.

reward_rules.display_note: Up to 50x on selected partner offers

scenarios.name: D20 min_txn is inclusive; legacy category cap converts to points
scenarios.why: ₹1,000 meets the ₹1,000 minimum: 40 pts. The legacy ₹10 reward-value cap is 40 pts at ₹0.25/pt and counts 40.

reward_rules.display_note: Up to 50x on selected partner offers

scenarios.name: D21 below the minimum falls to base; legacy category cap still binds
scenarios.why: ₹999 misses the minimum: base 9 pts, but the legacy apparel cap has only 5 pts left.

reward_rules.display_note: Up to 50x on selected partner offers

scenarios.name: D22 max_txn_inr splits the spend
scenarios.why: 5% on the first ₹5,000 (₹250) + 1% base on the other ₹3,000 (₹30) = ₹280.

scenarios.name: D23 bonus cashback cap
scenarios.why: 10% of ₹2,000 = ₹200: base ₹20 + bonus ₹180, but only ₹60 of bonus is left: ₹80.

scenarios.name: D24 eligible-spend cap then a custom post-cap rate
scenarios.why: ₹500 of headroom at 5% (₹25) + ₹2,500 at the custom 2% (₹50) = ₹75.

scenarios.name: D25 card-level category exclusion
scenarios.why: Rent is in the card's excluded categories: nothing earned, rule_id null.

scenarios.name: D26 per-block half-up rounding
scenarios.why: ₹150 is 1.5 blocks, rounded half-up to 2: 2 x 2 = 4 pts.

scenarios.name: D27 fractional points with a bonus cap
scenarios.why: No rounding: ₹150 = 1.5 blocks x 2 = 3 pts (card base 1.5 + bonus 1.5); the bonus cap counts 1.5.

scenarios.name: D28 implicit base uses the unit block
scenarios.why: No rule applies (swipe); the implicit base is 2 pts per ₹150 (unit block, not accrual_block_inr 100, D9.4): floor(299/150) = 1 block = 2 pts.

scenarios.name: D29 whole-points half-up rounding
scenarios.why: points_half_up: ₹250 x 3/₹100 = 7.5 -> 8 pts (base 2.5 -> 3, bonus 5).

scenarios.name: D30 legacy merchant_pattern without slugs still restricts
scenarios.why: D9.2: no merchant_slugs, so the v1 pattern 'bigbasket' applies as a substring: 4% of ₹1,000 = ₹40.

scenarios.name: D31 spend above max_txn counts toward a total cap
scenarios.why: D9.5: ₹2,000 at 5% = ₹100 (base ₹20 + bonus ₹80) + ₹3,000 at 1% = ₹30; the ₹100 card-wide cap allows ₹100. The bonus cap with no amount is skipped (D9.9).

scenarios.name: D32 post_cap_rate 0 with no behaviour means zero
scenarios.why: D9.3: the spend cap has post_cap_behavior null and post_cap_rate 0, so overflow earns nothing: ₹1,000 at 5% = ₹50.

scenarios.name: D33 equally binding spend caps: the first wins
scenarios.why: D9.8: both dining caps have ₹500 left; the first (post-cap zero) binds, so the other ₹1,000 earns nothing: ₹50. Both count ₹500.

scenarios.name: D34 count cap counts 1 even when the spend cap is exhausted
scenarios.why: D9.8: no movie spend headroom, so ₹600 earns the 1% base (₹6); the count cap still consumes 1.

scenarios.name: D35 legacy category spend cap on the implicit base
scenarios.why: D9.9/D9.5: ₹500 of headroom = floor(500/150) x 2 = 6 pts; the ₹400 overflow at base = floor(400/150) x 2 = 4 pts, rounded separately: 10 pts.

scenarios.name: D36 inactive parent still counts as an ancestor
scenarios.why: D9.10: 'NEW BRAND' resolves to newbrand, whose parent oldbrand is inactive but still an ancestor: 8% = ₹80.

scenarios.name: D37 inactive merchant is never resolved
scenarios.why: D9.10: 'OLD BRAND' only matches an inactive merchant, so the merchant is unknown: base 1% = ₹10.

scenarios.name: D38 a base-role rule earns at its own rate
scenarios.why: D9.1: n-base pays 2 pts/₹100 although the card base is 1: 1.5 blocks x 2 = 3 pts.
